Side by side

Fiberglass vs concrete vs vinyl

The question every Florida buyer asks first.

FiberglassConcreteVinyl liner
Typical install2–6 weeks3–6 monthsSeveral weeks
Surface feelSmooth gelcoatTextured plaster or pebbleSoft vinyl
Algae resistanceHigh (non-porous)Lower (porous)Medium
Shape freedomChoose from moldsUnlimitedMany shapes
Big future costRareResurfacingLiner replacement
Best forFast, low-upkeep family poolsFully custom designsLowest upfront price

Sources: install times from Barrier Reef Pools USA and published industry guides. Cost and lifespan vary by project. iTop gives you a firm price after the site visit.
